note: Rule 2A of the Income-tax Rules, 1962 (which sets the 40%/50%-of-salary HRA exemption formula and the metro city list) is not part of either source PDF in docs/source-pdfs - both PDFs contain Act text only, not the Rules. This file was populated from general public knowledge at the user's explicit direction, not extracted from the provided PDFs. exemption_formula: least of: (a) actual HRA received, (b) rent paid minus 10% of (basic salary + DA), (c) 50% of (basic salary + DA) for metro cities or 40% for non-metro cities
